tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Prepare offline dependencies
tasks.detail: Fetch the pinned third-party sources Build-Installer.ps1 needs into Launcher/artifacts/dependencies

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Build translator CLI
tasks.detail: dotnet build the Translator CLI (Release) so Generate-BuildShards.ps1 has something to run

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Generate build shards
tasks.detail: Translate the base game once (needs Assets/main.dol + Assets/StaticR.rel) so runtime/ can configure

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Build prerequisites
tasks.detail: Everything Build-Installer.ps1 needs before it can run: offline deps + translator CLI + build shards

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Build installer
tasks.detail: Run Launcher/Build-Installer.ps1 end to end (native_prebuilt, publish, package)

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Build standalone UI
tasks.detail: dotnet build the standalone install/play UI (WiiCompiled.SimpleUI) - no Wheel Wizard involved

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Publish standalone UI (single exe)
tasks.detail: dotnet publish WiiCompiled.SimpleUI as one self-contained exe to Launcher/dist, same flags Build-Installer.ps1 uses for the setup host

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Build all standalone exes
tasks.detail: Build installer (compiler + toolkit, embedded) and publish the UI (single exe) together into Launcher/dist

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Publish standalone UI (debug, single exe)
tasks.detail: dotnet publish WiiCompiled.SimpleUI as a self-contained Debug exe (no optimizations, full PDBs) to Launcher/dist/debug - for diagnosing the UI itself, not for distribution.

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Publish standalone Setup (debug, single exe)
tasks.detail: Publishes WiiCompiled.Setup as a self-contained Debug exe (no optimizations, full PDBs) to Launcher/dist/debug/WiiCompiled-Setup.exe, then re-hosts the real installer payload from Launcher/dist/WiiCompiled-Setup.exe onto it - so it gets .NET Debug diagnostics but can still run --silent/compile the game. Not for distribution. Requires 'WiiCompiled: Build installer' to have produced Launcher/dist/WiiCompiled-Setup.exe first.

tasks.label: WiiCompiled: Rebuild installed base with PC tracing (diagnostic)
tasks.detail: Rebuilds the installed Base/WiiCompiled.exe directly via LocalBuild.ps1 with -EmitPcTrace, so the next crash report shows the exact faulting guest instruction instead of an approximate stack-scan guess. Every lowered instruction writes its own address into ctx->pc, so this build is slower than normal - diagnostic only, never shipped, and never left cached as reusable by a later ordinary build. Close the game first (it locks Base/WiiCompiled.exe).
